name: google-docs
description: Read/write Google Docs content (table rows, paragraphs, hyperlinks) via the Docs API — no browser. Append or delete table rows, set a cell to plain text, a bulleted list, or a short clickable hyperlink, or replace a doc's whole body from Markdown while its link stays the same. Reuses the gmail plugin's OAuth client with a separate token scoped to the documents API.
